avis.texte: This moisturizer that I tried in exchange for my review really made my skin feel amazing which came as a big surprise since I do live in the Windy City where weather can go below zero and winds are strong as can be. I usually have skin peeling around my eyebrows and my nose, especially while sick. However, while using this moisturizer, I noticed a significant decrease in my skin flaking or peeling around my nose, even though I was sick for about a month. I really like the packaging because it's convenient to bring while traveling instead of lugging around a glass container like most moisturizers. The only reason I don't give it five stars is because I'm not sure if this product or another product I just added to my routine is clogging my pores a bit. Even with this in mind, I still recommend this cream to anyone who struggles with dry skin especially during the colder months.

avis.titre: Soothing and Lightweight, Great for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I've been using the Madagascar Centella Cream as the last step of my skincare routine, both morning and night. The texture is lightweight but still moisturizing enough to keep my skin comfortable throughout the day. It absorbs quickly and doesn't feel greasy or heavy, which I really like. What stands out the most is how soothing it feels. My skin can get a bit sensitive and slightly red sometimes, and this cream helps calm it down without causing irritation. It layers well under sunscreen and makeup too. The only small downside is that if you have very dry skin, you might need a thicker moisturizer on top during colder weather. But overall, it works very well for normal to combination and sensitive skin.

This is a great moisturizer and feels good on the face not sticky or tacky. It's good prep for makeup application and budget friendly. It's not world changing but does the job. I received this free for my honest review.

This moisturizer made my skin feel amazing . During the winter my skin gets really dry and upon applying a small pea sized amount of product onto my face my skin felt amazing. The overall packaging of this product feels and looks luxurious which was a plus. The fragrance itself is light as well as the formula so no need to worry about a scent being overpowering or harsh on the skin. The moisturizer is very gentle on the skin and I love that it is peta vegan and cruelty free.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I received the Skin1004 Madagascar Centella Cream for free for testing purposes, and overall it's been a really solid moisturizer. The texture is lightweight yet hydrating, and a little goes a long way, which makes the amount of product feel generous. It absorbs well into the skin and keeps my face moisturized throughout the day without creasing or feeling heavy. I also noticed a light scent, but it didn't cause any irritation or sensitivity for me. Overall, it's a dependable daily cream that leaves skin feeling comfortable, smooth, and hydrated all day.

avis.titre: I love this moderately thick cream!
avis.texte: Some things I love about this product is that it sits really comfortably on the skin, especially as a night cream. I tend to use lighter cream but this was an exceptional product and I use it everyday ( mostly as a night cream )! Works well under makeup base

First off, I was gifted this in exchange for a review, but I am genuinely going to put this into my regular rotation. I have sensitive skin and this is so gentle and feels so good on my skin. It's not heavy or greasy but it still keeps my skin so moisturized for so long. The scent is pleasant and not overwhelming at all. I love the packaging as well and the price point is so affordable, especially considering how great the product is. I will be re-ordering this as soon as I finish this tube.

This is the second product I've used from this brand and I was not disappointed. With the harsh winter wind, this cream was perfect at night to rehydrate my skin. It is lightweight and doesn't cause my skin to breakout like many moisturisers do! It soaks in quickly and by the morning, my skin looks plump and supple! No strong scent either, which is important for me. I love the clean look of the bottle as well. I would definitely recommend this cream
I love this stuff! It's very hydrating and makes my skin so soft! I was in Europe and saw this at some high end perfume store, that made me like it even more!

avis.titre: Perfect for Dry and Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I received this cream for free in exchange for an honest review. At first, I was a bit skeptical because it isn't very thick, and I usually prefer richer creams since my skin has become sensitive and much drier after 35. I was pleasantly surprised when I tried it. First, it smells amazing, but most importantly, despite being lightweight, it provides great hydration. A little goes a long way and is more than enough for both face and neck. My skin feels soft, nourished, and comfortable after using it. I would definitely recommend this cream and would happily purchase and use it again.

This is a lightweight moisturizer, suitable for all skin types. I have combo/dry, acne-prone skin with some rosacea and I can use it morning and night. If I was on the oilier side I would stick to just using it at night. It has a nice light lavender scent that didn't irritate my skin (or my nose). It dries down nicely, wears well under makeup, and soothes the redness on my cheeks. It doesn't feel sticky after application, and a little goes a long way!

I've been on a long skincare journey, trying to find the right products for my acne prone sensitive skin. This moisturizer is exactly what I have been looking for and needing. Buy it! You won't regret it. The second it touched my face for the first time, it instantly calmed down any redness and irritation. I use this as the last step in my nighttime routine.

avis.titre: I would be this product again
avis.texte: I'm delighted to share my honest thoughts on the Madagascar Centella Cream, which I had the opportunity to try out as a free product in exchange for this comprehensive review. My first impression began with the packaging, which truly exudes a sense of luxury and sophistication. Its elegant design and premium feel instantly convey that a high-quality product lies within, making it a beautiful addition to any skincare collection. A feature I particularly appreciate, and one that makes this cream stand out, is its completely fragrance-free formulation. For those with sensitive skin or who simply prefer to avoid added scents in their skincare, this is a significant advantage and something I truly love about it. Regarding its performance, this cream is an absolute marvel for hydration. It deeply moisturizes the skin, leaving it feeling incredibly soft, supple, and perfectly balanced. After consistent use, I've observed a remarkable transformation in my complexion. My skin now boasts a healthy, radiant glow, feels distinctly firmer to the touch, and overall appears much healthier and revitalized. The consistency is another strong point. It's beautifully lightweight, far from being heavy or greasy, and glides onto the skin with effortless ease. It absorbs remarkably quickly without leaving any sticky residue, making it an ideal choice for layering with other products or applying under makeup. Overall, the Madagascar Centella Cream has thoroughly impressed me with its elegant present

I've been using the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Cream, and it's quickly become a staple in my routine. The texture is lightweight but still feels nourishing, and it absorbs into my skin almost instantly without leaving any greasy or heavy residue. I love that I can use it both morning and night without worrying about how it will sit under makeup. What I appreciate most is how calming it is. Whenever my skin feels irritated or looks a bit red, this cream noticeably soothes it. The Centella Asiatica really makes a difference. My skin feels more balanced and less reactive, especially on days when I've used actives or my skin barrier feels compromised. It also does a great job of hydrating without clogging my pores. My skin feels soft, comfortable, and moisturized for hours, not oily or weighed down. Over time, I've noticed my skin looks healthier and more resilient overall.
I'm so glad I received free sample because it's exactly what my skin needed doing this time. This cream is very moisturizing but light, very creamy. It give my skin a nice glow
I loved this cream it was so lightweight but also moisturizing and really improved my skin

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I use it all the time as apart of my skincare care routine and it's very comfortable for my skin! I highly recommend it !
Love this cream! It has no fragrance and goes on the skin like butter. Great for all skin types, even oily skin like mine. Doesn't leave a greasy residue or cause your makeup up melt off.

avis.titre: So moisture and so calming, melted in my skin right way
avis.texte: It was so moisturizing and calming; it melted into my skin right away. The texture was a bit thick when I squeezed the product on my hand to apply on the skin; however, it melted and blended into my skin so quickly and was absorbed almost immediately.

avis.titre: Healthy and soothing new moisturizer my dry skin was craving
avis.texte: I was given the opportunity to experience Madagascar Centella Cream in exchange for my honest review. I've never used this brand before but am very grateful, and so is my skin. I could tell a difference the very first time I used it. It goes on creamy and smooth and doesn't 'sit' on top like most moisturizers. I patted on my face, around my eyes and of course my décolleté. My sensitive face feels hydrated and soothed. I used it twice a day as the very last step in my skincare regimen. I'm going to continue and make other new choices from this line. The ingredients are clean, cruelty free and vegan-these are important to me in my life now more than ever. I would highly recommend this to anyone with dry, sensitive skin looking for a lightweight, calming moisturizer that actually absorbs. It is effective for soothing irritation and providing all-day hydration. I would happily repurchase this myself.

I was gifted the Madagascar Centella Cream and I'm pleasantly surprised — it's lightweight, soaks in quickly, and calmed my redness while keeping my skin comfortably hydrated without feeling greasy, though it's not rich enough for very dry patches and has a mild scent that might not suit everyone; overall, a lovely gentle everyday cream for sensitive or combination skin — thanks for the gift

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Face Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm really impressed. The texture is lightweight but still hydrating, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasiness. My skin feels calmer and less irritated, especially around areas that tend to get red. I also love that it doesn't have a strong scent. If you have sensitive or combination skin, this cream is gentle, soothing, and great for daily use.
It is a cream that moisturizes and softens the skin, leaves the face soft and the makeup looks spectacular. I am dry-skinned and I loved this cream.

I received the Madagascar Centella Cream and have been enjoying it so far! My skin is combination, and it feels moisturized without being sticky. I also love the subtle scent which is very gentle and pleasant. I've been using it at night only for a week, so I'll need more time to see results.

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Cream and it's become a staple in my skincare routine. It feels light yet nourishing, calming my skin and helping with redness without feeling heavy or greasy. My skin looks smoother and more balanced, a great daily moisturizer if you're into gentle, effective skincare.

I was sent this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling app program. The Madagascar Centella Cream had a good texture to it, it didn't feel greasy or heavy. My skin absorbed it nicely and it felt hydrating.

I loved this moisturizer because it was nice and thick, so you only need a small amount, but when you put it in it's so lightweight and doesn't clog pores! It doesn't have an overbearing smell and wast greasy throughout the day. I have somewhat sensitive, combination skin and I really did like this one.
I liked it a lot, for this season it helps me a lot my skin reddens a little and this cream calms me down besides that deeply hydrated

I love that this is very lightweight & not heavy at all. I find it to be really moisturizing & not oily like others. I have oily skin & this works great for me. Plus the very minimal smell is great too!

I started using the Madagascar centella cream recently, and it's quickly become a staple.The pure Centella from Madagascar instantly calms irritation on my cheeks.Within a week, my skin looked less red and noticeably smoother.The cream has a clean, lightweight texture that sinks in without any stickiness.It gives solid hydration even though it feels airy on the skin.My barrier feels more resilient, especially during colder days.Overall, it's a reliable, gentle cream that delivers exactly what it promises.

I received this Madagascar Centenella cream as a free sample program but I would buy it again and again. I have very dry skin and nothing seems to work during winters. This cream is very apt for dry skin coz it keeps your skin hydrated for long period of time. It gives a soft shiny finish and is good for both day and night moisturizing routine. I would definitely buy it again and would recommend it for people with dry skin.
I loved the moisturizing cream. It was super lightweight and didnt feel heavy at all. It made my skin so soft! I will be adding to my skincare rotation.

Skin1004 Madagascar Centella Cream is an essential part of my skincare routine. I love to pair this with the Madagascar Centella Ampoule as it literally saved my skin during and after cancer treatment. I was getting terrible acne that wouldn't clear up with prescription medications and antibiotics. Once I started my routine with the ampoule and cream, my skin started to look more vibrant, hydrated, while minimizing my redness and acne flare ups. The smallest amount is needed, and it keeps my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. Makeup looks nicer, it just lays smoother on top of my skin now. Plus it doesn't aggravate my eczema. It's definitely worth a try if you're new to Centella products. I received a complimentary sample from skin1004 in exchange for an honest review.*

avis.titre: I would love to buy this product again and again

I'd definitely recommend it to my friends and family—it's lightweight, hydrating, and soothing.

I am in total love with this cream. I use it daily and I can see the results. My skin appears smooth and glowy. It is moisturized and dewy. This product helps prep my skin for makeup application. Recommend!
